title: IELTS Lesson 01 — Parts of Speech & Word Formation

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: Her [[decision]] surprised the entire team.
questions.explanation_vi: Decision gọi tên một quyết định, đứng sau tính từ sở hữu her.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: They will [[decide]] after the interview.
questions.explanation_vi: Decide diễn tả hành động quyết định, đứng sau will.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The committee reached a [[decisive]] conclusion.
questions.explanation_vi: Decisive bổ nghĩa cho danh từ conclusion.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: She responded [[decisively]] to the complaint.
questions.explanation_vi: Decisively bổ nghĩa cho động từ responded.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The [[development]] of the city has accelerated.
questions.explanation_vi: Development là danh từ chỉ quá trình phát triển.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The company plans to [[develop]] a new product.
questions.explanation_vi: Develop là động từ nguyên mẫu sau to.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: We live in a highly [[developed]] area.
questions.explanation_vi: Developed mô tả area; highly bổ nghĩa cho tính từ.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The report describes the issue [[accurately]].
questions.explanation_vi: Accurately bổ nghĩa cho động từ describes.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The figures in the report are [[accurate]].
questions.explanation_vi: Accurate là tính từ sau linking verb are.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The [[accuracy]] of the results matters.
questions.explanation_vi: Accuracy là danh từ sau the.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: She spoke with remarkable [[confidence]].
questions.explanation_vi: Confidence là danh từ sau giới từ with.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: He answered the questions [[confidently]].
questions.explanation_vi: Confidently bổ nghĩa cho answered.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The new policy is [[effective]].
questions.explanation_vi: Effective mô tả chủ ngữ policy sau is.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The changes were implemented [[effectively]].
questions.explanation_vi: Effectively bổ nghĩa cho implemented.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The [[effectiveness]] of the training was measured.
questions.explanation_vi: Effectiveness là danh từ trung tâm của cụm chủ ngữ.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: Students need to [[analyse]] evidence carefully.
questions.explanation_vi: Analyse là động từ sau need to.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: Her [[analysis]] was detailed and balanced.
questions.explanation_vi: Analysis là danh từ sau her.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: This is an [[analytical]] approach.
questions.explanation_vi: Analytical bổ nghĩa cho approach.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: He considered the problem [[analytically]].
questions.explanation_vi: Analytically bổ nghĩa cho considered.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The course provides [[practical]] experience.
questions.explanation_vi: Practical bổ nghĩa cho experience.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: They [[practise]] speaking every evening.
questions.explanation_vi: Practise là động từ chính (chính tả Anh-Anh).

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: Regular [[practice]] improves fluency.
questions.explanation_vi: Practice là danh từ làm chủ ngữ.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The price increased [[dramatically]] last year.
questions.explanation_vi: Dramatically bổ nghĩa cho increased.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: There was a [[dramatic]] increase in prices.
questions.explanation_vi: Dramatic bổ nghĩa cho increase.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The sudden [[increase]] worried customers.
questions.explanation_vi: Increase ở đây là danh từ sau the sudden.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: Prices may [[increase]] next month.
questions.explanation_vi: Increase sau may là động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The [[research]] was published yesterday.
questions.explanation_vi: Research là danh từ không đếm được trong câu này.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: Researchers [[research]] how children learn.
questions.explanation_vi: Research là động từ chính, theo sau chủ ngữ researchers.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The system works [[reliably]] under pressure.
questions.explanation_vi: Reliably bổ nghĩa cho works.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: We need a [[reliable]] internet connection.
questions.explanation_vi: Reliable bổ nghĩa cho connection.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The [[reliability]] of the data is uncertain.
questions.explanation_vi: Reliability là danh từ sau the.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The teacher gave a clear [[explanation]].
questions.explanation_vi: Explanation là danh từ sau tính từ clear.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: Could you [[explain]] the process to me?
questions.explanation_vi: Explain là động từ nguyên mẫu sau could.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The document contains [[explanatory]] notes.
questions.explanation_vi: Explanatory bổ nghĩa cho notes.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The instructions were surprisingly [[simple]].
questions.explanation_vi: Simple là tính từ sau were.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The app was designed [[simply]].
questions.explanation_vi: Simply bổ nghĩa cho was designed.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The [[simplicity]] of the interface helps users.
questions.explanation_vi: Simplicity là danh từ sau the.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The applicant is [[qualified]] for the role.
questions.explanation_vi: Qualified là tính từ chỉ trạng thái/đủ điều kiện.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: She hopes to [[qualify]] for the programme.
questions.explanation_vi: Qualify là động từ sau to.

questions.prompt: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word: The [[qualification]] is recognised internationally.
questions.explanation_vi: Qualification là danh từ làm chủ ngữ.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The instructions were written with great ______. (CLEAR)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau with great cần danh từ clarity.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: Please explain the procedure ______. (CLEAR)
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho explain cần trạng từ clearly.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: Her ______ to continue studying impressed us. (DETERMINE)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau her cần danh từ determination.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: She remained ______ despite the setbacks. (DETERMINE)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau remained cần tính từ determined.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The team worked ______ to meet the deadline. (EFFICIENT)
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho worked cần trạng từ efficiently.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The new system improved operational ______. (EFFICIENT)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau operational cần danh từ efficiency.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: We need a more ______ solution to this problem. (PRACTICE)
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho solution cần practical, không phải practice.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: She gave a very ______ presentation. (INFORM)
questions.explanation_vi: Informative = cung cấp nhiều thông tin; bổ nghĩa cho presentation.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The public needs reliable ______ about the policy. (INFORM)
questions.explanation_vi: Information là danh từ không đếm được.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: His answer contradicted the evidence and was completely ______. (LOGIC)
questions.explanation_vi: Illogical = thiếu logic; completely bổ nghĩa cho tính từ.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The argument was presented ______. (LOGIC)
questions.explanation_vi: Trạng từ logically bổ nghĩa cho presented.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The programme aims to reduce social ______. (EQUAL)
questions.explanation_vi: Reduce social inequality = giảm bất bình đẳng xã hội.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: Everyone deserves ______ treatment. (EQUAL)
questions.explanation_vi: Equal là tính từ bổ nghĩa cho treatment.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The company must act ______ when hiring staff. (FAIR)
questions.explanation_vi: Fairly bổ nghĩa cho act, nghĩa là công bằng.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The decision raised concerns about ______. (FAIR)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau about cần danh từ fairness.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The report provides a ______ comparison. (DETAIL)
questions.explanation_vi: Detailed bổ nghĩa cho comparison.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: She described the incident in ______. (DETAIL)
questions.explanation_vi: In detail là cụm cố định.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The machine operates ______. (AUTOMATIC)
questions.explanation_vi: Automatically là trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho operates.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The process is almost entirely ______. (AUTOMATE)
questions.explanation_vi: Automated mô tả quy trình đã được tự động hóa.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The results were statistically ______. (SIGNIFICANCE)
questions.explanation_vi: Statistically significant là collocation học thuật.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The price has risen ______ over the past decade. (SIGNIFICANT)
questions.explanation_vi: Significantly bổ nghĩa cho risen.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The company announced a major ______. (EXPAND)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau a major cần danh từ expansion.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: They plan to ______ their services abroad. (EXPANSION)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau plan to cần động từ expand.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The new evidence is highly ______. (PERSUADE)
questions.explanation_vi: Persuasive là tính từ nghĩa là có sức thuyết phục.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: She argued ______ for additional funding. (PERSUADE)
questions.explanation_vi: Persuasively bổ nghĩa cho argued.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The manager handled the situation ______. (PROFESSION)
questions.explanation_vi: Professionally bổ nghĩa cho handled.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: He showed a high level of ______. (PROFESSIONAL)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau of cần danh từ professionalism.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The instructions were ______ to beginners. (CONFUSE)
questions.explanation_vi: Confusing mô tả điều gây khó hiểu; không dùng confused.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The students felt ______ by the instructions. (CONFUSE)
questions.explanation_vi: Confused mô tả cảm xúc của students.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The software has been ______ improved. (CONTINUE)
questions.explanation_vi: Continuously bổ nghĩa cho improved, nhấn mạnh tính liên tục.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: There has been a ______ improvement in quality. (NOTICE)
questions.explanation_vi: Noticeable bổ nghĩa cho improvement.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The proposal was rejected because it was ______. (REAL)
questions.explanation_vi: Unrealistic = không thực tế; vì thế bị từ chối.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The figures do not ______ reflect actual costs. (ACCURATE)
questions.explanation_vi: Accurately bổ nghĩa cho reflect.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The study highlights the ______ of early education. (IMPORTANT)
questions.explanation_vi: Sau the cần danh từ importance.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: She completed the assignment ______. (SUCCESS)
questions.explanation_vi: Successfully bổ nghĩa cho completed.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: He was ______ in securing a scholarship. (SUCCESS)
questions.explanation_vi: Successful là tính từ sau was.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The two approaches differ ______. (CONSIDERABLE)
questions.explanation_vi: Considerably bổ nghĩa cho differ.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: There is a ______ difference between the two methods. (CONSIDER)
questions.explanation_vi: Considerable = đáng kể, bổ nghĩa cho difference.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: The teacher encouraged ______ thinking. (CREATE)
questions.explanation_vi: Creative bổ nghĩa cho thinking.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets: Her ______ helped solve the problem. (CREATE)
questions.explanation_vi: Creativity là danh từ làm chủ ngữ.

questions.prompt: The teacher gave a clear ______ of the rule. [noun from EXPLAIN]
questions.explanation_vi: Clear bổ nghĩa cho danh từ explanation.

questions.prompt: Could you ______ the rule to me? [verb from EXPLANATION]
questions.explanation_vi: Could + động từ nguyên mẫu explain.

questions.prompt: The chart contains ______ notes for new users. [adjective from EXPLAIN]
questions.explanation_vi: Explanatory bổ nghĩa cho notes.

questions.prompt: The team made an important ______ yesterday. [noun from DECIDE]
questions.explanation_vi: Make a decision là collocation.

questions.prompt: We must ______ whether to accept the offer. [verb from DECISION]
questions.explanation_vi: Must + động từ nguyên mẫu decide.

questions.prompt: She acted ______ when the system failed. [adverb from DECISIVE]
questions.explanation_vi: Decisively bổ nghĩa cho acted.

questions.prompt: The course improved her ______ in English. [noun from FLUENT]
questions.explanation_vi: Fluency là danh từ sau her.

questions.prompt: He can speak English ______. [adverb from FLUENT]
questions.explanation_vi: Fluently bổ nghĩa cho speak.

questions.prompt: The applicant sounded ______ during the interview. [adjective from CONFIDENCE]
questions.explanation_vi: Sounded là linking verb, theo sau là tính từ.

questions.prompt: She answered every question ______. [adverb from CONFIDENCE]
questions.explanation_vi: Confidently bổ nghĩa cho answered.

questions.prompt: The data must be checked for ______. [noun from ACCURATE]
questions.explanation_vi: For accuracy là cụm giới từ cần danh từ.

questions.prompt: Please record the measurements ______. [adverb from ACCURATE]
questions.explanation_vi: Accurately bổ nghĩa cho record.

questions.prompt: This training programme is highly ______. [adjective from EFFECT]
questions.explanation_vi: Effective là tính từ sau is.

questions.prompt: The policy was implemented ______. [adverb from EFFECTIVE]
questions.explanation_vi: Effectively bổ nghĩa cho implemented.

questions.prompt: The firm wants to improve its ______. [noun from EFFICIENT]
questions.explanation_vi: Its + danh từ efficiency.

questions.prompt: The staff completed the task ______. [adverb from EFFICIENT]
questions.explanation_vi: Efficiently bổ nghĩa cho completed.

questions.prompt: The new evidence is ______. [adjective from SIGNIFICANCE]
questions.explanation_vi: Significant là tính từ sau is.

questions.prompt: Sales increased ______ last quarter. [adverb from SIGNIFICANT]
questions.explanation_vi: Significantly bổ nghĩa cho increased.

questions.prompt: The report includes a detailed ______ of the results. [noun from ANALYSE]
questions.explanation_vi: Analysis là danh từ sau detailed.

questions.prompt: We need to ______ the results before publishing. [verb from ANALYSIS]
questions.explanation_vi: Need to + động từ nguyên mẫu analyse.

questions.prompt: She adopted an ______ approach to the problem. [adjective from ANALYSIS]
questions.explanation_vi: Analytical bổ nghĩa cho approach.

questions.prompt: The programme aims to ______ students' skills. [verb from IMPROVEMENT]
questions.explanation_vi: Aim to + động từ nguyên mẫu improve.

questions.prompt: There has been a steady ______ in performance. [noun from IMPROVE]
questions.explanation_vi: A steady + danh từ improvement.

questions.prompt: The company hired an experienced ______. [noun for a person from MANAGE]
questions.explanation_vi: Manager là người quản lý.

questions.prompt: She is responsible for project ______. [noun from MANAGE]
questions.explanation_vi: Project management là cụm danh từ.

questions.prompt: The plan seems ______ given the budget. [adjective from REALITY]
questions.explanation_vi: Realistic mô tả tính khả thi của plan.

questions.prompt: We should assess the costs ______. [adverb from REALISTIC]
questions.explanation_vi: Realistically bổ nghĩa cho assess.

questions.prompt: The information is not ______ enough to use. [adjective from RELY]
questions.explanation_vi: Reliable là tính từ nghĩa là đáng tin cậy.

questions.prompt: The website performs ______ during peak hours. [adverb from RELIABLE]
questions.explanation_vi: Reliably bổ nghĩa cho performs.

questions.prompt: The article was written in ______ language. [adjective from SIMPLICITY]
questions.explanation_vi: Simple bổ nghĩa cho language.

questions.prompt: Please explain the process ______. [adverb from SIMPLE]
questions.explanation_vi: Simply bổ nghĩa cho explain.

questions.prompt: The new rules created unnecessary ______. [noun from CONFUSE]
questions.explanation_vi: Confusion là danh từ sau unnecessary.

questions.prompt: The instructions were ______, so nobody understood them. [adjective from CONFUSE]
questions.explanation_vi: Confusing mô tả nguyên nhân gây khó hiểu.

questions.prompt: The participants looked ______ after the lecture. [adjective describing people from CONFUSE]
questions.explanation_vi: Confused mô tả trạng thái của người.

questions.prompt: The campaign raised public ______ of the issue. [noun from AWARE]
questions.explanation_vi: Raise awareness là collocation.

questions.prompt: Many residents are still ______ of the risks. [negative adjective from AWARE]
questions.explanation_vi: Unaware of = không nhận thức được.

questions.prompt: The team showed remarkable ______ under pressure. [noun from RESILIENT]
questions.explanation_vi: Resilience là danh từ chỉ khả năng phục hồi.

questions.prompt: She remained ______ despite several failures. [adjective from RESILIENCE]
questions.explanation_vi: Resilient là tính từ sau remained.

questions.prompt: The project requires careful ______. [noun from PREPARE]
questions.explanation_vi: Preparation là danh từ sau careful.

questions.prompt: Students should ______ thoroughly for the exam. [verb from PREPARATION]
questions.explanation_vi: Should + động từ nguyên mẫu prepare.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / speaks / English / fluent.
questions.explanation_vi: Fluent là tính từ; cần fluently để bổ nghĩa cho speaks.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / informations / are / reliable.
questions.explanation_vi: Information là danh từ không đếm được; không thêm -s.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: He / made / a / decide.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau a cần danh từ decision.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: They / worked / very / efficient.
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho worked cần efficiently.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: Her / explain / was / helpful.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau her làm chủ ngữ cần danh từ explanation.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / results / were / accuracy.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau were mô tả results cần tính từ accurate.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: This / is / an / importance issue.
questions.explanation_vi: Trước issue cần tính từ important.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: He / completed / the / task successful.
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho completed cần successfully.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / training / was / effectiveness.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau was cần tính từ effective.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: They / will / decision / tomorrow.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau will cần động từ decide.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / is / a / confidence speaker.
questions.explanation_vi: Trước speaker cần tính từ confident.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / manager / spoke / polite.
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho spoke cần politely.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / proposal / sounds / reasonably.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau linking verb sounds cần reasonable.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / feels / happily / today.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau linking verb feels cần happy.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / solution / is / practically.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau is cần tính từ practical.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: They / gave / me / an advice.
questions.explanation_vi: Advice không đếm được; dùng some advice hoặc a piece of advice.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: We / need / more / equipments.
questions.explanation_vi: Equipment không đếm được; không thêm -s.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / research / were / useful.
questions.explanation_vi: Research là danh từ không đếm được trong ngữ cảnh này; dùng was.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / provided / many / evidences.
questions.explanation_vi: Evidence thông thường không đếm được; dùng pieces of evidence.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: They / have / made / progresses.
questions.explanation_vi: Progress nghĩa là sự tiến bộ thường không đếm được; dùng progress.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: Please / explain / me / the rule.
questions.explanation_vi: Explain the rule to me; không dùng explain me the rule.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: He / suggested / me / a solution.
questions.explanation_vi: Suggest a solution to me; không dùng suggest me a solution.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / described / me / the problem.
questions.explanation_vi: Describe the problem to me.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: I / am / interested / on science.
questions.explanation_vi: Interested in science, không phải interested on.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: He / is / responsible / of training.
questions.explanation_vi: Responsible for training.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: They / are / capable / to succeed.
questions.explanation_vi: Capable of succeeding; capable + of + V-ing.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / decided / studying / abroad.
questions.explanation_vi: Decide to study, không dùng decide studying.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: We / avoided / to make / mistakes.
questions.explanation_vi: Avoid + V-ing: avoided making.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: They / succeeded / to complete / the project.
questions.explanation_vi: Succeed in + V-ing: succeeded in completing.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: He / insisted / to pay / the bill.
questions.explanation_vi: Insist on + V-ing: insisted on paying.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / team / discussed / about the issue.
questions.explanation_vi: Discuss the issue, không cần about.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / entered / into / the room.
questions.explanation_vi: Enter the room (trong nghĩa đi vào phòng); không cần into.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / teacher / emphasized / on accuracy.
questions.explanation_vi: Emphasize accuracy, không cần on.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: His / performance / was / impressively.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau was cần tính từ impressive.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / answered / the question / confident.
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho answered cần confidently.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: Her / argument / was / persuasion.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau was cần tính từ persuasive.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / document / contains / explain notes.
questions.explanation_vi: Trước notes cần tính từ explanatory.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: She / spoke / with / confident.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau with cần danh từ confidence.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: The / system / operates / reliable.
questions.explanation_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho operates cần reliably.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect segment: They / demonstrated / great / creative.
